'''2012 US Nationals Day 1 Marc Hanson DS Vader's Lightsaber''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Marc Hanson]] at [[2012 US Nationals]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Vader's Lightsaber|Premiere-D-vaderslightsaber.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
